SELECT c.state, AVG(CAST(x.n AS REAL)) AS avg_records_per_college, AVG(CAST(x.n AS REAL) / totals.total_n) AS avg_share_of_total
FROM (
  SELECT pc.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM player_college AS pc
  JOIN college AS c ON CAST(pc.college_id AS TEXT) = CAST(c.college_id AS TEXT)
  GROUP BY pc.college_id, c.state
) AS x
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n
  FROM (
    SELECT pc.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c ON CAST(pc.college_id AS TEXT) = CAST(c.college_id AS TEXT)
    GROUP BY pc.college_id, c.state
  )
) AS totals
GROUP BY c.state
